headword: {満場一致|まんじょういっち}

definitions.gloss: unanimous; unanimous agreement; with the whole assembly in agreement
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound meaning that everyone present agreed. Used to describe decisions, votes, and approvals where there is no dissent.

examples.japanese: {満場一致|まんじょういっち}で{可決|かけつ}した。
{議案|ぎあん}は{満場一致|まんじょういっち}で{承認|しょうにん}された。
{新|あたら}しい{委員長|いいんちょう}は{満場一致|まんじょういっち}の{支持|しじ}で{選出|せんしゅつ}された。
examples.english: The new chairperson was elected with unanimous support.

notes:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character compound). {満場|まんじょう} (the whole hall) + {一致|いっち} (agreement). Used in formal contexts — meetings, votes, official decisions — and rarely in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満場一致|まんじょういっち}で{可決|かけつ}する: to pass unanimously
- {満場一致|まんじょういっち}で{承認|しょうにん}する: to approve unanimously
- {満場一致|まんじょういっち}で{採択|さいたく}する: to adopt unanimously
- {満場一致|まんじょういっち}の{支持|しじ}: unanimous support

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}: unanimous (in a formal body) — interchangeable; often used for governing bodies
- {全員賛成|ぜんいんさんせい}: everyone in favor — plainer, used in less formal meetings
- {異口同音|いくどうおん}: with one voice — emphasizes everyone saying the same thing, often spontaneous
